mainEntity.name: Can an existing garage be converted into a mother-in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing garage into an in-law suite is an effective way to gain living quarters within your current building footprint without sacrificing yard area. However, there are practical trade-offs to evaluate. You gain usable, climate-controlled living space while avoiding new exterior foundation work, but you sacrifice covered vehicle parking and primary storage space. Structurally, a garage conversion requires adding drywall to unfinished framing, leveling or insulating concrete floors, installing dedicated heating and cooling, and running new plumbing lines for a bathroom. Reviewing where vehicles and stored items will go helps confirm if a garage conversion is the best path.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, garages can be converted into living suites by adding drywall, insulation, HVAC, and plumbing, though you must trade covered parking and garage storage for that new space.
